input_data.earnings_summary: Amazon delivered a strong Q4 2023 performance, reporting revenue of $169.96 billion, up 14% year-over-year, exceeding analyst estimates of $166.2 billion. Net income came in at $10.6 billion with GAAP EPS of $1.00, a massive improvement from the $0.03 EPS in Q4 2022 when the company was navigating a cost reset. AWS revenue grew 13% YoY to $24.2 billion, reaccelerating from the prior quarter's 12% growth as cloud optimization headwinds eased. Advertising revenue reached $14.65 billion, up 27% YoY — one of the fastest-growing segments. Operating income hit $13.2 billion (7.8% operating margin), far above the $2.7 billion in Q4 2022. For Q1 2024, Amazon guided revenue of $138-143.5 billion and operating income of $8-12 billion.
